case_name: Sachin And Ors vs Krishna Kumari Nangia And Ors
facts_of_case: The plaintiffs seek a decree of partition by metes and bounds, possession of property AB-14, Safdarjung Enclave, Community Centre, New Delhi. The plaintiffs claim that their mother purchased the property during her husband's lifetime and constructed various shops and rooms from his own funds.

legal_principles.principle: Any child of a void and voidable marriage shall be legitimate, whether born before or after the commencement of the Marriage Laws (Amendment) Act, 1976.
legal_principles.held: Notwithstanding that marriage is null and void under section 11, any child of such marriage who would have been legitimate if the marriage had been valid, shall be legitimate
cited_cases: Shree Bhagwan and Ors v. Suraj Bhan and Ors (2006 VIII AD (Del) 380)
Bharatha Matha and Anr v. R. Vijaya Renganathan and Ors (AIR 2010 SC 2685)

legal_principles.principle: The mere fact that the plaintiffs are the children of late Shri Pran Nath Nangia would itself give rights to the plaintiffs in the suit property.
legal_principles.held: The mere fact that the plaintiffs are the children of late Shri Pran Nath Nangia, would itself in view of the provisions of Section 16 of the 1955 Act give rights to the plaintiffs
cited_cases: Shree Bhagwan and Ors v. Suraj Bhan and Ors (2006 VIII AD (Del) 380)
Bharatha Matha and Anr v. R. Vijaya Renganathan and Ors (AIR 2010 SC 2685)

use_for_drafting: claiming declaration and rendition of accounts in a joint family dispute
